purpose: Improve the public homepage and its linked explanatory pages so visitors understand the product, their role-specific value, the ordinary deal journey, trust boundaries and the existing registration next step.
effectiveAfter: The independent governance PR adding this manifest is reviewed and merged to main. The implementation must use that accepted base manifest and must not create or widen its own scope.
requiredInvariants: Only the explicitly listed public presentation, localization, acceptance and test paths may change; the global specification and serialized domain programme are unchanged.

The implementation creates or modifies no GitHub Actions workflow, production/release/merge gate, repository authority or automation. Focused UI and registration-boundary verification must use existing CI plus the explicitly listed tests and acceptance evidence.

The active tsconfig aliases currently route the public homepage through PlatformV7StrategicHomeInternational and route home/story/organization copy through the *-product wrappers into the *-operating layers. Those rendered layers are explicitly in scope; source-only base copy must not be mistaken for the live visitor text.

PlatformV7StrategicHomeInternational may be reduced to a transparent locale-safe delegator after its useful content is moved into the canonical homepage source. It must not keep hidden React-tree surgery that silently removes sections or injects a second public conversion flow on top of PlatformV7StrategicHome.

The public strategic-home and international-home CSS layers are in scope only to remove conflicting/hidden presentation authority and to achieve responsive, keyboard, focus, touch-target, readable-text and intrinsic-reflow acceptance. CSS must not replace source text through pseudo-elements or hide source text merely to substitute different marketing copy.

HydrationSafeChatSupport currently mounts the legacy DOM translation bridge on both `/platform-v7` and `/platform-v7/contact`. Once those two routes own complete locale-native RU/EN/ZH source copy, this file may stop loading the legacy bridge on those two routes only, while preserving the bridge for legacy public routes that still need dictionary-based DOM translation and preserving assistant/support behavior.

The explicitly listed Gekta product-separation and public-brand regressions may be adapted only to stop depending on the International wrapper's hidden tree surgery. They must continue enforcing canonical Gekta spelling, no retired TAI public identity, the separate canonical Gekta product route, the platform Gekta scenario boundary and the safety of the floating/product entry points.

The explicitly listed homepage, typography, mobile-density, strategic-home, root-entry, public-copy-quality and public-role regression suites may replace superseded literal 12-role/19-stage, mandatory-deviation, hidden-wrapper and unlabelled-example expectations with behavior checks for the user-authorized nine-role clarity, ordinary deal journey, single-source visible copy and clearly labelled examples. Security, registration, consent, authorization, protected-route, accessibility and data-integrity assertions must not be removed, skipped, weakened or changed merely to obtain a passing result.

platformV7PublicCopyQuality.test.ts may be expanded to cover the changed linked public pages so internal maturity jargon, artificial CRM/lead wording and misleading registration-like assistance copy cannot reappear there; it must keep the existing protected registration/navigation assertions and may not weaken their coverage.

The actual runtime copy owners imported through the product and operating layers by PlatformV7StrategicHome, PlatformV7AccountingClosureValue and OrganizationConnectForm are explicitly scoped; acceptance constants alone must not be mistaken for rendered-copy authority.

PublicDealRoleScenario may change only the public explanatory selector from legacy twelve-role presentation to the requested nine-role visitor taxonomy; protected role definitions, authorization, registration role assignment and cabinet routing remain unchanged.

The nine public visitor roles are exactly seller, buyer, logistics, driver, elevator/storage, laboratory, surveyor, bank/finance and platform employee. Operator, compliance, arbitration or management subfunctions may be explained inside the platform-employee perspective but must not be advertised as additional visitor roles or used to alter protected authorization.
PublicDealRoleScenario.module.css may change only for responsive, keyboard, focus, touch-target and intrinsic-reflow quality of that explanatory selector; it confers no access authority.

The accounting-closure homepage block may be simplified or reworded so unconfirmed 1C/EDI routes are not presented as live integrations; accounting, EDI, payment and external-adapter behavior remain unchanged.

Contact page source, metadata and fixed header may become locale-aware in RU, EN and ZH, but the contact API, form field contract, consent requirement, validation, submission and success semantics remain unchanged.

ContactCopyNormalizer may retire the legacy client-side DOM text rewriting once ContactClient owns the localized source copy. Its compatibility export may remain a no-op; contact API requests, consent, validation, submission and registration semantics are unchanged.
Registration, authentication, role assignment, organization creation, reviewer authority, tenant isolation, RBAC, API endpoints, database schema and production topology are unchanged.
The byte-bound terms and privacy policy page sources, consent versions, consent hashes, clients and PostgreSQL consent-evidence whitelist are unchanged.

PrivacyPortalPanel may replace invented personal consent records and local-only success actions with truthful links to existing support. It must not redefine the policy, fabricate an operator or recipient, or claim a request was submitted without a durable response.

Organization-intake copy and presentation may clarify that the public intake is optional assistance and not the protected registration path; submission, validation, consent, persistence, idempotency, replay conflicts, rate limits and no-JavaScript boundaries are unchanged.

On the homepage the existing protected `/platform-v7/register` route is the only primary conversion: header, hero and final primary registration CTAs must point there; product/deal exploration is secondary; the presentation PDF is tertiary; organization-intake assistance is visually and textually separate and must not be presented or labelled as registration.
Public explanations use capability and user-outcome language in RU, EN and ZH; external integrations, legal operator details, provider fees and contractual promises are not fabricated.
Public examples are labelled, use illustrative values and separate the ordinary successful journey from deviations and disputes; role choices confer no access authority.
Primary registration calls to action navigate to the existing public registration entry. Presentation downloads remain accessible and their bytes, routes and filename are unchanged.
Public trust and explanatory links resolve to existing public destinations; protected routes remain protected.

Responsive acceptance checks ordinary navigation and role selection without submitting registration or contact forms. Pointer targets, keyboard focus, readable text and intrinsic reflow are verified at the declared widths.
Fresh production visual evidence must identify the actual deployed revision and viewport. Historical images or source-only checks cannot be represented as current desktop or mobile acceptance.
The acceptance record distinguishes completed checks, failures, untested items and pending deployment; it does not claim universal 100/100 usability or guaranteed registration intent.
forbiddenChanges: production, release, merge or existing security workflows
acceptance: The exact implementation diff is a subset of allowedPaths from the independent accepted governance base.
Source-controlled scope resolution, autopilot guard, production-hosting authority and exact-head review-gate contract checks pass.
Focused web unit tests, relevant role/route/copy regressions and web typecheck are recorded with their actual results using existing CI; the implementation adds no workflow authority.
Desktop and mobile checks cover 320, 375, 390, 430, 768, 1280 and 1440 CSS-pixel widths, with live visuals and unresolved gaps recorded honestly.
Registration and consent source hashes match the accepted base; no auth, identity, API, database, lockfile, tsconfig or PDF change is present.
A completed exact-head code review is bound to the current PR head; all substantive required CI checks are terminal and green before merge.
Any later production release uses the existing canonical REG.RU exact-SHA workflow and requires healthy running OCI revision and live-domain evidence before being called deployed.
